description: Classification of retired package-coupled tests and engine-neutral retained coverage.

coupling.reason: These adapter tests depend on the current editor binding, ProseMirror-facing view behavior, retired package document types, or adapter-owned toolbar, file-open, and TOC proxy wiring, but they still describe durable user-visible behavior.

intent.summary: React and Vue adapter load lifecycle, toolbar visibility, file-open customization, comment-threading, context-menu focus, visible scroll behavior, and TOC proxy behavior tied to the current editor binding.

coupling.reason: These bridge integration tests exercise the current editor bridge and reviewer bridge surfaces that are layered directly over the retired package architecture.

intent.summary: Editor bridge, reviewer bridge, and hosted MCP integration behavior exposed on top of the retired bridge contracts.

coupling.reason: These headless reviewer tests operate directly on the current headless document model, tracked-change surface, comment surface, and save/reload behavior of the retired package surface.

intent.summary: Headless read/search/comment/change/note-body/save-roundtrip behavior bound to the retired headless core surface.

coupling.reason: These MCP stdio and server tests contain durable framing, lifecycle, and protocol-envelope behavior, but they instantiate the retired EditorBridge and route through its fixed tool surface.

intent.summary: MCP stdio chunking, lifecycle, initialization, error-envelope, and request-routing behavior currently coupled to the retired bridge.

coupling.reason: This test uses a synthetic retired EditorBridge, but it preserves durable shared tool-schema validation, normalization, and clean-text behavior that must be independently specified outside that bridge.

intent.summary: Tool schema compatibility with no empty enum members; rejection of invalid underline, highlight, and break values; highlight 'none' normalization; and clean-text reads that exclude revision and comment-anchor annotations.

coupling.reason: These runtime and type-level parity tests only assert the current bridge method surface and adapter ref contract, not durable document behavior.

intent.summary: Runtime and type-level method-presence parity checks for the retired bridge wrapper and adapter refs.

coupling.reason: These adapter tests assert the hidden PM host and painted-pages event and guard lifecycle used by the current adapter implementations, not durable editor behavior.

intent.summary: Hidden PM host portal behavior and painted-pages event and guard lifecycle internals.

coupling.reason: This React adapter test reaches a utility re-export from the removed core implementation surface, so it does not exercise an adapter-owned engine-neutral implementation.

intent.summary: Adapter re-export coverage for the retired package font-option normalization utility.

coupling.reason: These are utility-level, UI-level, and declaration-contract tests with no dependency on the retired package surface, headless reviewer, or ProseMirror binding.

intent.summary: Adapter UI, declaration-contract, and i18n utility behavior that should remain live through the engine migration.

coupling.reason: This test validates JSON-RPC line framing, response encoders, type guards, and standard error codes without importing or instantiating the retired bridge.

intent.summary: Transport-neutral JSON-RPC framing and protocol primitives that remain valid without retired engine or bridge semantics.
